name: Water-ice extraction & processing (ISRU)
question: We want to test digging up and processing water ice
nasa_basis: Artemis / Moon-to-Mars objectives: in-situ resource utilisation (water ice) for propellant, life support

gates.why: needs real ice/frozen ground, not just a cold place

name: Power & thermal-extreme hardware testing
question: We want to test solar power, batteries and hardware against extreme light and temperature swings
nasa_basis: Surface power & thermal control for Artemis base camp / Mars surface systems

gates.why: rain/humidity would invalidate dust and thermal tests

name: Rover mobility, landing & autonomy testing
question: We want to drive rovers and test landing and navigation
nasa_basis: Lunar Terrain Vehicle / Mars rover traverse and landing-site hazard needs

gates.why: vegetation changes wheel-soil behaviour and sensor tests

name: Habitat, construction & radiation shelter
question: We want to build and test habitats, regolith construction and underground shelters
nasa_basis: Surface habitat, construction and lava-tube shelter studies for long-duration stays

name: Geology & astrobiology science
question: We want to do geology, sample collection and search for signs of past life
nasa_basis: Mars 2020 / Artemis science objectives: geology, mineralogy, astrobiology

gates.why: analog must be dry like Mars/Moon surface

name: Crew operations & isolation analog missions
question: We want to train crews: EVA, isolation and operations in a hostile environment
nasa_basis: Analog missions (NEEMO, HI-SEAS, CHAPEA style) for crew and operations readiness
